title: Bee Removal in Dyker Heights, Brooklyn
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Dyker Heights, Brooklyn. Licensed technicians, structural nest treatment. (855) 930-5016
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nest removal throughout Dyker Heights, Brooklyn. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest — whether it's inside a wall void, soffit, attic, shed, or underground — and treat and remove it to protect your home or business. Honeybee colonies are referred to a licensed beekeeper after identification.
whyUs: Our team has extensive experience serving Dyker Heights' unique mix of single-family homes, multi-family residences, and local businesses, understanding the specific challenges posed by bee infestations in this Brooklyn neighborhood. We use safe, eco-friendly removal methods that protect both your property and the local ecosystem, with same-day and emergency services available throughout Dyker Heights.
localContext: Dyker Heights is known for its beautiful residential streets, the famous Christmas lights displays, and proximity to Dyker Beach Park and Golf Course, where flowering plants and mature trees attract wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets to nearby homes. The neighborhood's classic brick homes, eaves, soffits, and garden sheds provide ideal nesting sites for paper wasps, bald-faced hornets, and carpenter bees drilling into wooden trim and pergolas. Wall voids in older structures can harbor large yellow jacket colonies that expand unnoticed until residents see aggressive defenders near entries.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Dyker Heights?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Dyker Heights?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How do you approach treatments where children and pets live?
faqs.answer: We use EPA-registered products with targeted application to the nest itself — whether it's inside a wall void, under an eave, or in the ground. Our licensed technicians explain the products used and re-entry timing so you know exactly when it's safe for children and pets to return to the area. Entry points are sealed after treatment to prevent recolonization.

faqs.question: What types of properties do you service in Dyker Heights?
faqs.answer: We provide wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal for all property types in Dyker Heights — single-family homes, multi-family buildings, apartment complexes, commercial properties, and outdoor structures. Whether the nest is in a wall, attic, chimney, soffit, shed, or underground, our experienced team locates and treats it.
